item.title: OpenSnitch
item.description: As I was reading about Nftables and eBPF, I thought struck in my mind that there are firewall rules to block/control incoming connections. You can install Gufw which is a graphical frontend to ufw. By clicking a button, you can deny all unauthorized incoming connections. Yes, you can control outgoing connections too but for that you have to create manual rules and it is not as easy as it sounds. Wouldn’t it be great if I can view each outgoing connection on connection to connection basis. As I was reading about eBPF and Linux network programming, so I knew that for each connection a socket is created and if I am able to hook into kernel functions responsible for socket creation I would be able to intercept and see every outbound connection.
